utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Let's get cracking, quick stand-up for Monday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Morning. Grim out there, isn't it? Proper sideways rain. Weekend was basically cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tell me about it. And the ring road was absolute carnage this morning, took me forever to get in.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, same here. Everyone forgot how to drive in a bit of rain again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Standard. Right, safety, priorities, blockers. Keep it tight if we can. Priya, you first?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, so, no major issues from me. Just to say I signed off the inspection on the Stretch Wrapper on Tuesday, so that's done and closed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely, cheers. Anything live today?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nothing major-major. Electrical side's fairly steady.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: On maintenance, I tested the pump in the pit yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's not hanging over us anymore.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good stuff.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Only thing I noticed walking through, I heard a slight rattle from the stretch wrapper, nothing to action yet, just keeping an ear on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, noted, observation only for now.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've got one blocker, supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller. I've chased them again but still nothing back.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, blocker noted. Keep poking them, but yeah, that's outside us at the minute.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: If they leave it much longer we'll all have retired before it turns up.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Honestly, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Let's go through today's bits. David—Whitty—can you do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances by Wednesday? It's not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I can do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances by Wednesday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip, got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And while I've got you, Whitty, can you schedule downtime for the big board with production?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll schedule downtime for the big board with production. I'll grab them after this.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: They were asking about windows for that last week actually, so that'd help.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect. Priya, can you sort the training records for the new starters by end of day, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Uh, today I'm a bit boxed in, to be honest. I've still got the panel fault on two and the audit follow-up. I don't think I'll get the training records for the new starters done by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Mide, can you pick that up instead—sort the training records for the new starters by end of day, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll sort the training records for the new starters by end of day, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: What else have we got?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Line 3 Screw and Barrel still needs the paperwork side lining up before we touch it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's the permit side, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Line 3 Screw and Barrel next week. Drop everything for that one, really, because if that's not right we're not going near it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, thanks Tomasz. So that's yours for next week, and yeah, drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: While we're on safety kit, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks Aisha, appreciated.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Makes sense to get that done before the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There's also the stretch wrapper. We need to book a contractor to look at the stretch wrapper next Tuesday, whenever you get a chance. Can anyone take that?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Not me, I'm stacked with shutdown planning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't, not this week.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, not from my side.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same, no capacity.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Afraid not.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, fine, so we need to book a contractor to look at the stretch wrapper next Tuesday, whenever you get a chance, but nobody's picking it up right now. Fiona, can you at least flag that gap in the planner?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I can note that it's unowned, but I'm not taking it as an action.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's fine, just visibility.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next one: the gas valve on one. Tomasz, can you replace the seals on the gas valve on one at half two?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At half two I can't, I've got the contractor escort and then stores. I won't make that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Doyler, can you take it instead—replace the seals on the gas valve on one at half two?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Me? Bit left field, but yeah, okay, I can replace the seals on the gas valve on one at half two if that's what we need.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll show you where the kit is before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Please do, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, thanks both.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've also got one I'll pick up: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Main Water Isolation Valve.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good man. Thanks, Olumide Adeyemi.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That'll help because ops were asking who had final sign-off on that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, leave that with me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Anything else for utilities?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just checking we've not missed anything obvious.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, apart from me not touching those training records now, that's clear, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, clear. Priya's not taking that, Mide's got it by end of day, whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: For the counterbalances, do you want all trucks or just the usual pair?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Do the full pre-use checks on the counterbalances, please. By Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, all of them then. Fine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And on the big board, Whitty, if you get production to give an actual slot, send it me and I'll put it into the plan.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, will do. I'll schedule downtime for the big board with production and pass you the window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: By the way, if this weather keeps up I'm bringing a canoe tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You can park it next to Fiona's car after the ring road.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Oi, don't. I nearly turned round and went home.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No chance, not with month end coming. Right, recap then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Whitty is doing the pre-use checks on the counterbalances by Wednesday, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Whitty is also going to schedule downtime for the big board with production.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mide is going to sort the training records for the new starters by end of day, whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz will sort the permit to work and isolation for the Line 3 Screw and Barrel next week, drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha will recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We still need to book a contractor to look at the stretch wrapper next Tuesday, whenever you get a chance, and at the moment nobody owns it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Doyler is replacing the seals on the gas valve on one at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Olumide Adeyemi will do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Main Water Isolation Valve.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, got mine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Brilliant. Shout if anything changes. Thanks everyone.
